URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/5/14/trump-xi-summit-live-us-china-leaders-to-hold-talks-on-trade-tech-iran

US President Donald Trump arrived in Beijing on Thursday and was greeted by Chinese leader Xi Jinping in a welcoming ceremony at the Great Hall of the People. Two-day summit. First US presidential trip to Beijing in nearly a decade.

Xi Jinping opening remarks: called for a "diplomatic reset," stating that China and the US's shared interests "outweigh" their differences.

Trump's response: praised Xi as a "great leader" during the welcoming ceremony.

Topics on agenda: trade negotiations, technology issues, Iran-related matters, Strait of Hormuz implications, oil markets.
